This script generates figures used in the manuscript.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

require("knitr")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, eval = T, message = F, warning = F)

# Load functions
source(here::here("R/functions.R"), echo = F)
ogl <- readRDS(here::here('raw_data/threats/OGL_polygons.rds'))

colgrid <- readRDS(paste0(envir,'/colonies.RDS'))

# plot details
textSize <- 11
plotWid <- 6.5
plotHei <- 5

```

### Create base map

This creates a base map and some shapefiles that are used repeatedly in plotting.

```{r, include=FALSE}

# Used for spatial extent
dat <- readRDS(here::here('input_data/LHSP_locs_plus_PA.RDS')) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |> sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

# Relies on function in custom package available at https://github.com/allisonglider/seabiRds
bb <- seabiRds::bbox_at_zoom(dat)

coast_mp <- coast |> sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

eez <- sf::st_read(paste0(envir,'/EEZ_Canada/200_mile.shp')) |> sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

# Create a base map with bathymetry
b <- terra::rast(paste0(envir,'/bathymetry.nc'))
b <- terra::project(b, mp)
bath_base <- ggplot() +
  tidyterra::geom_spatraster_contour_filled(data = b, 
                                            breaks = c(seq(-10000,-1000,1000), seq(-750,0,250))) +
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.2, end = 1, guide = F) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_sf(data=coast_mp)
saveRDS(bath_base, paste0(envir,'/bath_base_map.RDS'))

bcont <- sf::st_as_sf(terra::as.polygons(terra::ifel(b > -300, 1, 0)))

## petroleum parcels
oog <- readRDS(here::here("raw_data/threats/threats_offshorePetro_licensePolygons.rds")) |> sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

## petroleum platforms
oogPts <- read.csv(here::here("raw_data/threats/threats_offshorePetro_productionInstallationPts.csv")) |> 
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c('lon','lat'), crs = 4326) |> 
  sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

```

### Figure 1: Study area

Format population data

```{r}

## colony data
pop <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("raw_data/LHSP Atlantic population survey data 10Sep2026.xlsx")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(popEst = as.numeric(`Estimated no. of mature individuals`)) |>
  dplyr::filter(popEst >= min_pop) |>
  dplyr::filter(Country %in% c("Canada", "France", "US")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Colony = gsub(" Island", "", Colony),
                Colony = gsub(" \\(Witless Bay\\)", "", Colony),
                Colony = gsub(" \\(Fortune Bay\\)", "", Colony),
                Colony = gsub(" \\(Grand Manan Archipelago\\)", "", Colony),
                Colony = gsub(", Whites", "", Colony),
                Colony = gsub(", South", "", Colony),
                trackStat = factor(ifelse(Colony %in% c("Baccalieu", "Gull", "Middle Lawn", "Country", "Bon Portage", "Kent"), "yes", "no"), ordered = T, levels = c("yes", "no"))) |>
  dplyr::select(Colony, Longitude, Latitude, popEst, trackStat) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) |>
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(mp))

```

Inset for Nova Scotia lease areas.

```{r}

my_pal <- c('#E69F00','#56B4E9','#009E73','#CC79A7')
names(my_pal) <- sort(unique(oog$Activity), decreasing = F)

ns_ogl <- ogl |> dplyr::filter(Province == 'NS')
bb_ns <- seabiRds::bbox_at_zoom(ns_ogl, zoom_level = 8)
box_ns <- sf::st_as_sfc(bb_ns, crs = mp)

lab_1 <- ns_ogl |> dplyr::filter(ProdArea == 'Panuke')
lab_2 <- ns_ogl |> dplyr::filter(ProdArea == 'Alma')
lab_3 <- ns_ogl |> dplyr::filter(ProdArea == 'South Venture')
sable <- coast_mp |> 
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(ogl)) |> 
  sf::st_crop(box_ns) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(label = 'Sable Island') |> 
  sf::st_centroid() 
sc <- sf::st_coordinates(sable) |> data.frame()

ns <- bath_base +
  geom_sf(data=ogl, aes(fill = license_type), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_pal) +
  coord_sf(xlim = bb_ns[c(1,3)], bb_ns[c(2,4)], label_axes = '--EN') +
  ggsflabel::geom_sf_text_repel(data=lab_1, aes(label = ProdArea), 
                                nudge_x = -15000, nudge_y = 15000, seed = 10, size = 2.25, bg = 'transparent') +
  ggsflabel::geom_sf_text_repel(data=lab_2, aes(label = ProdArea), 
                                nudge_x = -15000, nudge_y = -15000, seed = 10, size = 2.25, bg = 'transparent') +
  ggsflabel::geom_sf_text_repel(data=lab_3, aes(label = ProdArea), 
                                nudge_x = 10000, nudge_y = 15000, seed = 10, size = 2.25, bg = 'transparent') +
  annotate('text', x = sc$X, y = sc$Y -8000, label = sable$label, angle = 10, size = 2.25, fontface = "italic") +
  guides(fill = 'none') +
  labs(x = '', y  = '') +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "tr", width_hint = 0.5, style = 'ticks', 
                              text_cex = 0.4, height = unit(0.15, "cm")) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, 'mm'),
    legend.key.height = unit(4, 'mm'), 
    legend.key.spacing = unit(0, 'mm'),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black'),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = 'black')
  )
ns
```

Flowchart made in powerpoint

### Figure 3: GPS tracks

Map GPS tracks by breeding stage.

```{r map-allTracks}

dat <- readRDS(here::here('input_data/data_tracks_simplified.rds')) |> 
  sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

# Tracking data
tracks <- dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(ID) |>
  dplyr::summarize(do_union=FALSE) |>
  sf::st_cast("LINESTRING") 

# Return covariates to dataset
covs <- dat |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::group_by(ID) |>
  dplyr::summarize(colony = colony[1], 
                   status = status[1]) |>
  dplyr::mutate(colony = factor(colony, ordered = T, levels = c("Baccalieu", "Gull", "Middle Lawn", "Country", "Bon Portage", "Kent")),
                status = ifelse(status == "incubation", "Incubation", "Chick-rearing"),
                status = factor(status, ordered = T, levels = c("Incubation", "Chick-rearing"))) 

tracks <- dplyr::left_join(tracks, covs, by = "ID") 

# project colonies
trackCols <- colgrid |>
  dplyr::filter(colony %in% c("Baccalieu", "Gull", "Middle Lawn", "Country", "Bon Portage", "Kent")) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("collon", "collat"), crs = 4326) |>
  sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

# offshore facilities oogPts already projected

## Get plot extent based off tracking data, plus some wiggle room
bb <- sf::st_bbox(tracks)
bb[1] <- bb[1] - 100000
bb[2] <- bb[2] - 100000
bb[3] <- bb[3] + 100000
bb[4] <- bb[4] + 100000

# Facet by breeding stage, color by colony
p <- bath_base +
  facet_wrap(~status) +
  geom_sf(data = tracks, aes(color = colony), linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = eez, fill = 'transparent', col = "white", linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = oogPts, pch = 20, size = 1, color = "red") +
  geom_sf(data = trackCols, pch = 21, fill = "white", size = 1.5) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(bb[1], bb[3]), ylim = c(bb[2], bb[4])) +
  labs(x = '', y= '', color = '') +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 1, reverse = T, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1))) +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "br", height = unit(0.15, "cm"), text_col = "white", text_cex = 0.5, line_width = 0.5) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = textSize),
    legend.position = 'bottom',
    legend.margin= ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, 'mm'),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, 'mm'),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black')
  )

print(p)

#ggsave(here::here('plots_man/AllTracks_byStage.png'), p, units = 'in', width = plotWid, height = plotHei*0.75)

```


### Figure 4: Variable inclusion

```{r}

imp <- readRDS(here::here('output_data/bart_model_full_imp.RDS'))

tt <- data.frame(
  var = names(imp$avg_var_props),
  imp = imp$avg_var_props,
  sd = imp$sd_var_props
) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    var = dplyr::case_when(var %in% c('daynight_day','daynight_night') ~ 'daynight',
                           var %in% c('region_SS','region_NL') ~ 'region',
                           var %in% c('state_Foraging','state_Transit') ~ 'state',
                           var %in% c('status_chick-rearing','status_incubation') ~ 'status',
                           TRUE ~var
    )) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(var) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    imp = sum(imp),
    sd = sum(sd)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup()

tt$var <- factor(tt$var, tt$var[order(tt$imp, decreasing = TRUE)])

tt <- tt |> 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(imp)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    type = dplyr::case_when(var %in% c('logpop','collat',          
                                       'collon','collat', 
                                       'region') ~ 'Colony-specific',
                            var %in% c('colonydist','coastdist','competition','logpop','collat',          
                                       'shelfdist','elevation','collon','collat', 'slope') ~ 'Static',
                            var %in% c('so','thetao', 'chl','nppv','mnkc_hmlmeso','zooc','mnkc_epi', 
                                       'ssha','mnkc_mumeso','sstsd','sshsd', 
                                       'mlotst','currsd','current') ~ 'Dynamic',
                            var %in% c('status',
                                       'state',
                                       'daynight') ~ 'Conditional'),
    varname = dplyr::case_when(
      var == 'colonydist' ~ "Distance from colony",
      var == 'coastdist' ~ "Distance from coast",
      var == 'competition' ~ "Competition",
      var == 'logpop' ~ "Colony size",
      var == 'shelfdist' ~ "Distance from shelf",
      var == 'elevation' ~ "Bathymetry",
      var == 'collat' ~ "Colony latitude",
      var == 'collon' ~ "Colony longitude",
      var == 'region' ~ "Region",
      var == 'so' ~ "Salinity",
      var == 'slope' ~ "Slope",
      var == 'thetao' ~ "SST",
      var == 'chl' ~ "Chlorophyll a",
      var == 'nppv' ~ "NPP",
      var == 'mnkc_hmlmeso' ~ "HML micronekton",
      var == 'zooc' ~ "Zooplankton",
      var == 'mnkc_epi' ~ "Epipelagic micronekton",
      var == 'ssha' ~ "SSHa",
      var == 'mnkc_mumeso' ~ "MU mesopelagic micronekton",
      var == 'sstsd' ~ "SST gradient",
      var == 'sshsd' ~ "SSH gradient",
      var == 'mlotst' ~ "MLD",
      var == 'currsd' ~ "Current gradient",
      var == 'current' ~ "Current speed",
      var == 'status' ~ "Breeding status",
      var == 'state' ~ "Behaviour state",
      var == 'daynight' ~ "Time of day",
    ),
    cumsum = cumsum(imp),
    type = factor(type, levels = c('Colony-specific','Static','Dynamic','Conditional'))
  )

tt$varname <- factor(tt$varname, tt$varname[order(tt$imp)])

tt |> 
  dplyr::group_by(type) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    median = median(imp),
    sum = sum(imp)
  )

RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 4, name = 'Dark2')

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = tt, aes(y = varname, x = imp, fill = type), stat = 'identity') +
  geom_errorbarh(data = tt, aes(y = varname, xmin = imp - sd, xmax = imp + sd), height = 0) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Dark2') +
  labs(y = 'Predictor', x = 'Variable inclusion rate', fill = '') +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = textSize),
    legend.position = c(0.99, 0.01),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
  )
p
# ggsave(here::here('plots_man/variable_inclusion_rate.png'), p, units = 'in', width = 6.5, height = 5)

```


### Figure 5: SDM density predictions

Combine density for each month over all colonies.

```{r}

od <- here::here('plots_man/density_summaries')

mon_dens <- terra::rast()
mon_ci <- terra::rast()
nn <- c()
for (d in c('daily')) {
  for (mon in month.abb[6:9]) {
    fn <- list.files(od, pattern = mon, full.names = T)
    fn <- fn[grep(d, fn)]
    r <- terra::rast(fn)
    mon_dens <- c(mon_dens, r[[1]])
    mon_ci <- c(mon_ci, r[[3]] - r[[2]])
    nn <- c(nn, paste(month.name[month.abb == mon]))
  }
}

names(mon_dens) <- nn
names(mon_ci) <- nn

nval <- signif(colSums(terra::values(mon_dens) * terra::values(terra::cellSize(mon_dens, unit = 'km'), ID = F)[,1], na.rm = T), 3)
names(mon_dens) <- paste0(names(mon_dens), ' \n(n=', formatC(nval, big.mark=",", format = 'd'),')' )
names(mon_ci) <- paste0(names(mon_ci), ' \n' )

```

Plot median density over all colonies by month.

```{r}

colonies <- sf::st_as_sf(colgrid, coords = c('collon', 'collat'), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) |>

bb <- seabiRds::bbox_at_zoom(dat, zoom_level = 3.8)
bg <- viridis::turbo(n = 1, begin = 0, end = 0, alpha = 0.9)
options(scipen = 1000)

u2 <- expression('Density\nbirds/km'^2)

p <- ggplot() +
  tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = mon_dens) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'H', na.value = bg, alpha = 0.9) +

  geom_sf(data = bcont, fill = 'transparent', linetype = 1, linewidth = 0.2, col = 'white') +
  geom_sf(data = coast_mp, fill = grey(0.9), linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = colonies, aes(size = population), shape = 1, col = 'yellow') +
  facet_wrap(~lyr, nrow = 1) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.7, 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-90, 90, 10)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-120, 90, 10)) +
```

### Figure 6: Compare density by license area

```{r}

od <- here::here('plots_man/all_risks')

out <- extract_dens(source = od, extract_areas = ogl, modlab = 'Breeding')

out <- out |> 
  dplyr::group_by(ProdArea,area_km2,Province,license_type,colony,month) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    med = sum(med),
    ll = sum(ll),
    ul = sum(ul)
  )

month_sum <- out |> 
  dplyr::group_by(Province, ProdArea, month, license_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    dens_med = sum(med),
    dens_ll = sum(ll),
    dens_ul = sum(ul)
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = out, aes(y = ProdArea, x = med, fill = colony), stat = 'identity') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = 'H', direction = -1) +

  facet_wrap(.~month, ncol = 1, dir = 'v') +
  labs(x = expression('Density, birds/km'^2), y = 'Licence Area', fill = '') +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = textSize),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.margin= ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, 'mm'),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, 'mm'),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black')
  )
```


Calculate the number of birds within a theoretical 89.3 km^2 light footprint if it were within each lease area. Generate barplots of results for number of birds.

```{r light-nbirds}

light_buff <- 89.3
out_bs <- out |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    med = med * light_buff,
    ll = ll * light_buff,
    ul = ul * light_buff,
  )

month_sum_bs <- out_bs |> 
  dplyr::group_by(Province, ProdArea, month, license_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    dens_med = sum(med),
    dens_ll = sum(ll),
    dens_ul = sum(ul)
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = out_bs, aes(y = ProdArea, x = med, fill = colony), stat = 'identity') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = 'H', direction = -1) +
  geom_errorbarh(data = month_sum_bs, aes(y = ProdArea, xmin = dens_ll, xmax = dens_ul), height = 0) +
  facet_wrap(.~month, ncol = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7.5, linetype = 3) +
  labs(x = 'Number of birds within light footprint', y = 'Licence Area', fill = '') +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = textSize),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.margin= ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, 'mm'),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, 'mm'),

    strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black')
  )

```

Calculate the proportion of population impacted by light pollution in a representative sample of licence areas.

```{r light-pop}

pa_list <- c('Sea Rose','South Venture','EN_1166','EN_1172','JDA_1164','SEN_1162')

out_pp <- out_bs |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(colgrid[,c('colony','population')]) |> 
  dplyr::filter(month == 'September', 
                ProdArea %in% pa_list) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    med = (med/population) * 100,
    ll = (ll/population) * 100,
    ul = (ul/population) * 100,
    colony = factor(colony, levels = colord[length(colord):1]),
    ProdArea = factor(ProdArea, levels = pa_list)
  ) 

plot_ALAN_pop <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = out_pp, aes(y = colony, x = med, fill = colony), stat = 'identity') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = 'H', direction = 1) +
  geom_errorbarh(data = out_pp, aes(y = colony, xmin = ll, xmax = ul), height = 0) +
  facet_wrap(.~ProdArea, nrow = 2) +
  guides(fill = 'none') +
  labs(x = 'Percentage of population (%) within light footprint', y = 'Colony', fill = '') +
  xlim(c(0, 0.06)) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.margin= ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, 'mm'),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, 'mm'),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black')
  )
plot_ALAN_pop
```

### Figure S6-S11: Tracks with OOG by colony

```{r}

dat <- readRDS(here::here('input_data/data_tracks_simplified.rds')) |> 
  sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

# Tracking data
tracks <- dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(ID) |>
  dplyr::summarize(do_union=FALSE) |>
  sf::st_cast("LINESTRING") 


# Return covariates to dataset
covs <- dat |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::group_by(ID) |>
  dplyr::summarize(colony = colony[1], 
                   status = status[1]) |>
  dplyr::mutate(colony = factor(colony, ordered = T, levels = c("Baccalieu", "Gull", "Middle Lawn", "Country", "Bon Portage", "Kent")),
                status = ifelse(status == "incubation", "Incubation", "Chick-rearing"),
                status = factor(status, ordered = T, levels = c("Incubation", "Chick-rearing"))) 

tracks <- dplyr::left_join(tracks, covs, by = "ID") 

# project colonies
trackCols <- colgrid |>
  dplyr::filter(colony %in% c("Baccalieu", "Gull", "Middle Lawn", "Country", "Bon Portage", "Kent")) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("collon", "collat"), crs = 4326) |>
  sf::st_transform(crs = mp)

# Plot for each colony in a loop
# Each will need its own bbox

for(i in c('Baccalieu', 'Gull', 'Kent')) {
  
  bb2 <- sf::st_bbox(tracks[which(tracks$colony == i),]) 
  bb2[1] <- bb2[1] - 100000
  bb2[2] <- bb2[2] - 100000
  bb2[3] <- bb2[3] + 100000
  bb2[4] <- bb2[4] + 100000
  
  # Tring to change ratio to fit exact plot dimentions, but struggling. Decided just to crop the outputs.
  #pRatio <- (-bb2[2]+bb2[4])/((-bb2[1]+bb2[3])*2)
  
  p <- bath_base +
    geom_sf(data = tracks[which(tracks$colony == i),], linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = oog, aes(fill = Activity, color = Activity), alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c('#E69F00','#56B4E9','#009E73','#CC79A7')) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c('#E69F00','#56B4E9','#009E73','#CC79A7'), guide = "none") +
    geom_sf(data = trackCols[which(trackCols$colony == i),], fill = "white",pch = 21, size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~status) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(bb2[1], bb2[3]), ylim = c(bb2[2], bb2[4])) +
    labs(x = '', y= '', fill = '') +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = textSize),
      legend.position = 'bottom',
      legend.margin= ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 1, 0, 'mm'),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 1, 0, 0, 'mm'),
      legend.box.margin = margin(-5, 0, 0, 0, "mm"),  # pull legend upward
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black')
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  #ggsave(here::here(paste0('plots_man/Tracks_Petroleum_', i, '.png')), p, units = 'in', width = plotWid, height = plotHei)
}


for(i in c('Bon Portage', 'Country', 'Middle Lawn')) {
  
  bb2 <- sf::st_bbox(tracks[which(tracks$colony == i),]) 
  bb2[1] <- bb2[1] - 100000
  bb2[2] <- bb2[2] - 100000
  bb2[3] <- bb2[3] + 100000
  bb2[4] <- bb2[4] + 100000
  
  # Tring to change ratio to fit exact plot dimentions, but struggling. Decided just to crop the outputs.
  #pRatio <- (-bb2[2]+bb2[4])/((-bb2[1]+bb2[3])*2)
  
  p <- bath_base +
    facet_wrap(~status) +
    geom_sf(data = tracks[which(tracks$colony == i),], linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = oog, aes(fill = Activity, color = Activity), alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c('#E69F00','#56B4E9','#009E73','#CC79A7')) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c('#E69F00','#56B4E9','#009E73','#CC79A7'), guide = "none") +
    geom_sf(data = trackCols[which(trackCols$colony == i),], fill = "white",pch = 21, size = 1.5) +
    #geom_sf(data = eez, fill = 'transparent', linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.1) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(bb2[1], bb2[3]), ylim = c(bb2[2], bb2[4])) +
    labs(x = '', y= '', fill = '') +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = textSize),
      legend.position = 'bottom',
      legend.margin= ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 1, 0, 'mm'),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 1, 0, 0, 'mm'),
      legend.box.margin = margin(-5, 0, 0, 0, "mm"),  # pull legend upward
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black')
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  #ggsave(here::here(paste0('plots_man/Tracks_Petroleum_', i, '.png')), p, units = 'in', width = plotWid, height = plotHei-1.5)
}

```

### Figure S12: Pct of population exposed

Percentage (%) of Leach’s Storm-petrel populations instantaneously exposed in September to A) ALAN from a typical offshore platform (with a light footprint of 89 km²), or B) oil pollution from a hypothetical spill (with a footprint of 200 km²) if it were located within different licence areas off the coasts of NL or NS. Examples are shown for September because this month had the highest densities of birds at risk. Note that estimates are instantaneous and represent the percentage of birds expected at a given time in September at each facility.
